name: Is it safe to clean mold myself after water damage?

mainEntity.name: Is it safe to clean mold myself after water damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: For small areas of mold (less than 10 square feet) on non-porous surfaces, you may attempt to clean it yourself using appropriate personal protective equipment, such as gloves and an N-95 respirator. However, if the mold covers a large area, is in HVAC systems, or if you suspect it's on porous materials like drywall or carpet, it is generally recommended to hire a professional. Improper cleaning can spread mold spores and worsen the problem, especially after water damage which often creates conditions for extensive growth.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can clean small mold patches on non-porous surfaces yourself with proper safety gear. For larger areas or porous materials, professional mold remediation is recommended to prevent spreading.
